spine: Judge ambition before its outcome by following evidence debt, correction channels and who bears the downside.
art: An ambitious prototype is tested on a workshop bench; a blocked measurement and accumulating evidence debt contrast with visible dissent, reversible milestones and a dignified stop.
lines: Too Convinced to Stop asks how ambitious beliefs can remain answerable to evidence.
The book judges the process before success or failure rewrites the story.
It follows founders and institutions through confidence, authority, dissent, and the distribution of costs.
Its category of impossible certainty is explicitly nonclinical.
Readers gain questions for distinguishing bold experimentation from organizational protection against correction.
